_moduleContext.name: Text Transform
_moduleContext.author: MAM Team
_moduleContext.description: Transform text between different cases and formats with length tracking
_moduleContext.purpose: Transform text between different cases and formats with length tracking
rules: Non-alphabetic characters (numbers, symbols, spaces) must be preserved
Empty strings must return empty results without errors
The original_length and new_length must accurately reflect character counts
snake_case and kebab_case must handle multiple consecutive spaces gracefully
Title case must capitalize the first letter of each word
